provisions.label: T1
provisions.quote: Surveys shall be taken at intervals not exceeding 30 m in any build or turn section and 90 m in tangent sections.
provisions.reason: Technical survey-frequency standard; states no charge, rate or payment record.

provisions.label: T2
provisions.quote: MWD surveys shall meet the ISCWSA error model for the tool; gyro surveys shall be run where magnetic interference is expected.
provisions.reason: Survey quality obligation. It says when gyro surveys must be run but not whether or how they are charged; any gyro charge follows the rate schedule.

provisions.label: T3
provisions.quote: No section shall be drilled without an approved anti-collision report for the well.
provisions.reason: Operational prohibition; states no payment consequence and does not make the report a condition of payment.

provisions.label: T4
provisions.quote: Rotary steerable systems shall be capable of dog-leg severities of 6 degrees per 30 m in 12-1/4 inch and 8-1/2 inch hole.
provisions.reason: Tool capability specification only.

provisions.label: T5
provisions.quote: Motors shall be inspected and redressed after every run; redress is charged under Clause 26.
provisions.reason: Makes motor redress chargeable, once per run, and points to Clause 26 for the charge. The charging rule is Clause 26's; T5 restates it.

provisions.label: T6
provisions.quote: MWD tools shall transmit inclination, azimuth, tool face and gamma ray in real time.
provisions.reason: Tool functionality specification only.

provisions.label: T7
provisions.quote: The pressure while drilling module shall record annular and bore pressure at intervals not exceeding 10 seconds.
provisions.reason: Data-recording specification only.

provisions.label: T8
provisions.quote: Resistivity shall be measured at no fewer than four depths of investigation.
provisions.reason: Measurement specification only.

provisions.label: T9
provisions.quote: Density and neutron measurements require a radioactive source handled under Clause H6.
provisions.reason: Ties the LWD density/neutron service to H6 source handling, and H6 requires a Source Handling Certificate for every run, so it bears on the record for charging such runs. The effect is H6's (and the DDR/Schedule 5 record rule); T9 only cross-refers to it.

provisions.label: T10
provisions.quote: The sonic tool shall record compressional and shear slowness.
provisions.reason: Measurement specification only.

provisions.label: T11
provisions.quote: Pressure points shall be taken only at depths the Company Representative approves.
provisions.reason: Limits eligible formation pressure points to Company-Representative-approved depths, so unapproved points are not properly chargeable. Consistent with the classification's statement that it restates Clause 30 (Clause 30 text not visible to this reader).

provisions.label: T12
provisions.quote: The underreamer shall open the hole to not less than the diameter in the well programme and shall be verified by caliper.
provisions.reason: Performance standard with caliper verification. It is not expressed as a condition of payment. If Schedule 5 makes a caliper log evidence for underreaming charges, that rule belongs to Schedule 5, not here.

provisions.label: T13
provisions.quote: Cuttings bed monitoring shall be provided in 12-1/4 inch hole with inclination above 60 degrees.
provisions.reason: Service obligation in stated conditions; says nothing about whether or at what rate it is charged.

provisions.label: T14
provisions.quote: Drilling jars shall be run in every BHA below 17-1/2 inch hole where the Company requires.
provisions.reason: Operational BHA requirement; no charging rule stated.

provisions.label: T15
provisions.quote: A backup MWD tool and a backup rotary steerable system shall be kept at the rig site.
provisions.reason: Availability obligation. It does not say whether backup tools attract a charge; any standby or rental charge for backups would be governed by the rate/standby schedules.

provisions.label: T16
provisions.quote: Final logs and survey files shall be delivered within fourteen days of the end of the well.
provisions.reason: Data-delivery deadline. It is not stated as a condition of payment here; any such condition would sit in Schedule 5 / invoicing clauses.

provisions.label: P14
provisions.quote: All invoices are stated and paid in USD.
provisions.reason: Sets the currency of every invoice amount. A line stated in another currency is not valid as stated, and any amount priced elsewhere in another currency has to be expressed in USD. The heading 'P14. Currency of payment' is at the foot of p.11 and the body is the only text on p.12. Under P1 ('This Part amends Parts I to V and prevails over them'), P14 overrides any different currency rule in Parts I-V. It sits in the owner DDS-R20: that rule must require every invoice line and total to be stated in USD, and it should take P14's precedence over Parts I-V into account.

provisions.label: H1
provisions.quote: The Contractor shall comply with the Company's HSE management system.
provisions.reason: General compliance obligation; no charging effect.

provisions.label: H2
provisions.quote: No work shall start on the rig floor without a valid permit to work.
provisions.reason: Safety prohibition. It does not make a permit a condition of payment or bar charging.

provisions.label: H3
provisions.quote: Tools shall be secured against dropped objects when in the derrick.
provisions.reason: Safety practice only.

provisions.label: H4
provisions.quote: Lifting operations shall be planned and supervised by a competent person.
provisions.reason: Safety practice only.

provisions.label: H5
provisions.quote: Contractor personnel shall hold current well control certification.
provisions.reason: Personnel qualification. It is not linked to whether personnel are chargeable.

provisions.label: H6
provisions.quote: Radioactive sources shall be transported, stored and handled by licensed personnel, with a Source Handling Certificate for every run.
provisions.reason: Creates a per-run document, the Source Handling Certificate, for every run with a radioactive source (the LWD density/neutron runs, via T9). This is the record needed to support charging those runs. The classification says the certificate is DDR Part D and is owned by DDS-R15. That rule must require one Source Handling Certificate per radioactive-source run before the run's charges are admitted.

provisions.label: H7
provisions.quote: No explosives shall be brought to the rig site without written approval.
provisions.reason: Safety approval requirement; no charging effect.

provisions.label: H8
provisions.quote: Personnel shall carry H2S monitors in areas the Company designates.
provisions.reason: Safety practice only.

provisions.label: H9
provisions.quote: No person shall work more than twelve hours in any twenty-four.
provisions.reason: Fatigue limit. It states no payment consequence, so on its face it is not a charging rule. If Schedule 4 prices any personnel by the hour, it could be read as capping chargeable hours per person at 12 in 24. That is worth checking against the personnel rules, but it is not a clear valuation provision.

provisions.label: H10
provisions.quote: Any incident shall be reported to the Company Representative within one hour.
provisions.reason: Reporting duty; no charging effect.

provisions.label: H11
provisions.quote: Contractor waste shall be removed from the rig site.
provisions.reason: Contractor obligation. It does not say whether removal is chargeable.

provisions.label: H12
provisions.quote: Any spill shall be reported and cleaned up at once.
provisions.reason: Environmental duty; no charging effect.

provisions.label: R1
provisions.quote: The lead directional driller is responsible for the accuracy of the Contractor's entries on the Daily Drilling Report.
provisions.reason: Allocates responsibility for accuracy; no charging rule.

provisions.label: R2
provisions.quote: The Daily Drilling Report for a day is issued by 06:00 on the following day.
provisions.reason: Issue deadline. No payment consequence is attached to late issue.

provisions.label: R3
provisions.quote: Measured depths are stated in whole metres from the rotary table.
provisions.reason: Fixes the unit (whole metres) and datum (rotary table) of the depths from which metres drilled and depth-band placement are derived. It therefore governs quantity and band for any per-metre or depth-band charge (Schedule 2 depth bands). An owner must derive metres and bands from DDR measured depths in whole metres referenced to the rotary table.

provisions.label: R4
provisions.quote: Circulating hours are stated in whole hours, any part hour of thirty minutes or more counting as a whole hour.
provisions.reason: Rounding rule for circulating hours: 30 minutes or more rounds up to a whole hour, and less than 30 minutes is dropped. This changes the quantity of hour-based charges, and of the Clause 31 lost-in-hole hours used via P12. It matches the owner DDS.P.circulating_hour_rounding, which must use a 30-minute half-up threshold on whole hours.

provisions.label: R5
provisions.quote: The report lists by service code every rental tool in the hole at any time during the day.
provisions.reason: Makes the DDR's service-code tool list the record of which rental tools were in the hole on a day. That is the evidence for day-rate tool charges (compare P6: a failed tool is charged only on days the report records it in the hole). The owners must accept a rental-tool day only where the DDR lists that tool by service code. Code mapping is subject to OV-DDS-05 (codes superseded by 19A).

provisions.label: R6
provisions.quote: The report states, by service code, the number of the Contractor's personnel on the rig during the day.
provisions.reason: Makes the DDR headcount by service code the record that bounds personnel quantity per day. An owner must cap charged personnel per service code per day at the DDR count.

provisions.label: R7
provisions.quote: The status of the day is recorded by the Company Representative and is final for the purposes of Clause 19.
provisions.reason: Day status (e.g. Operating or Standby) sets which rate applies under Clause 19, and the Company Representative's entry is final. An owner must take day status only from the Company Representative's DDR entry and not allow the Contractor to reclassify it.

provisions.label: R8
provisions.quote: A report may be corrected only by a revision signed by both signatories before the invoice for the day is submitted.
provisions.reason: Determines which DDR version is admissible evidence. A correction is effective only if signed by both signatories and made before the invoice for that day. Unsigned or post-invoice corrections cannot support a charge.

provisions.label: R9
provisions.quote: The BHA Run Report is issued within two days of the end of the run and totals the circulating hours and metres of the Daily Drilling Reports for the run.
provisions.reason: Defines the BHA Run Report's hours and metres as the totals of the run's DDRs. So run-level quantities (e.g. circulating-hour or per-metre charges, lost-in-hole hours) must reconcile to the DDR sums. The two-day issue deadline carries no stated payment consequence.

provisions.label: R10
provisions.quote: Survey data are delivered in the Company's format within twelve hours of each survey.
provisions.reason: Data-delivery obligation. It is not stated as a condition of payment.

provisions.label: R11
provisions.quote: LWD data are delivered in real time where the tools allow and in memory form at the end of each run.
provisions.reason: Data-delivery obligation. It is not stated as a condition of payment.

provisions.label: R12
provisions.quote: The Contractor shall retain all field records for seven years after the end of the Contract.
provisions.reason: Record retention; no effect on what may be charged.

discrepancies: The owners account for R4 (DDS.P.circulating_hour_rounding) and, plausibly, the DDR service-code records in R5/R6 (DDS-R05, with codes via OV-DDS-05). R3 is not evidently covered: it sets whole metres from the rotary table as the depth unit and datum behind metres drilled and depth bands, but only hour rounding is parameterised and no depth/metre owner is named. R7 (Company Representative's day status is final for Clause 19), R8 (corrections only by a revision signed by both signatories before the day's invoice) and R9 (BHA Run Report totals equal the DDR sums for the run) are covered only if DDS-R05 is a general DDR-evidence rule that includes them. The owner names do not show this.

provisions.label: Sch 7 preamble
provisions.quote: Minimum specifications for the tools the Contractor provides. The hole sections shown are those the tool is designed for; which tools are in the hole on a day, and are charged, is as the Daily Drilling Report records (Clause 28).
provisions.reason: The only operative sentence. It bears on charging only by saying that the hole-section column does not limit charging: the tools in the hole on a day, and charged, are those the DDR records under Clause 28. It restates Clause 28 and must not be used to disallow a DDR-recorded tool because it ran outside its designed hole section.
